topologies.name: Mesh
topologies.description: Every agent connects to every other agent.

topologies.name: Star
topologies.description: A separate orchestrator connects to all five agents.

topologies.name: Ring
topologies.description: Agent 1–2–3–4–5–1; each agent has two neighbors.

topologies.name: Hierarchy
topologies.description: All task agents are leaves: Manager 1 supervises agents 1, 3, 4; Manager 2 supervises agents 2, 5.

topologies.name: Connected Erdos-Renyi (p = 0.5)
topologies.description: Sample G(5, 0.5) until connected: every agent is reachable from every other. Seed = 42; accepted sample 3. Pairwise non-isomorphic ER classes; uniqueness retries = 0.
topologies.model: G(n,p) conditioned on connectivity and uniqueness against earlier ER classes
topologies.uniqueness_scope: ER probability classes at the same agent count
